sources.title: Chord-Classification-Model-Accordo.ai - GitHub
sources.snippet: Accordo.ai is a system designed to provide real-time chord recognition from audio input. The project explores several deep learning approaches to accurately identify musical chords from audio signals, breaking down chord components into root notes, bass notes, triads, and fourth notes.
